configurations.//: ONE environment, deliberately. There were four — :3011 beta, :3012 released, :3013 released-and-configured, :3100 attaching to the shipping container — and three of them were the same build with different switches in front of it, which is a picker with four rows and one real entry. Edd cut it to this one on 2026-08-23.
configurations.//2: This is the most complete of them: a real build (`pnpm host`, ~5s, same Postgres and same models as production), plus `HR_RELEASE=true` so it shows the product as it will be the day pricing opens, plus the two Stripe fixtures so the pricing card renders `Get Pro`, plus `SOURCE_COMMIT` so `/api/health` reports a commit instead of `unknown`.
configurations.//3: ⚠️ It is therefore NOT what production serves today. Production is in beta: the word appears in the interface, every Pro capability is included, and an anonymous visitor's CV goes to the third-party model. To see that instead, run `pnpm host` in a terminal — no switches, port 3011 — which is what CLAUDE.md documents as the default loop and is unaffected by this file.
configurations.//4: The Stripe values are fixtures, not credentials, and are shaped so a scanner cannot mistake them for any. So the button renders and the checkout it starts fails at Stripe with a 502: everything up to the network is real, and whether Stripe accepts our payload needs Edd's keys (plan 01 block 3).
configurations.//5: What the deleted entries were, each one line if you want it back: released but unconfigured — `HR_RELEASE=true PORT=3012 pnpm host`. The shipping image, for .doc, OCR and the last check before a release — `pnpm app`, then browse http://localhost:3100. And before those there was a `hunterready-ui` on 3007 running Vite with HMR and proxying /api to the container; it went on 2026-08-18 once `pnpm host` was measured at five seconds.
configurations.name: hunterready
runtimeArgs: HR_RELEASE=true STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_fixture_not_a_credential_0000 HR_STRIPE_PRICE_ID=price_fixture_not_a_credential_0000 SOURCE_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD) PORT=3013 pnpm host
